title: Error Handling
description: Handle errors gracefully with GraphQL error formatting and custom exceptions.
longDescription: Good error handling makes your API reliable and your clients happy. This module teaches you how to throw GraphQL-compatible errors, implement global exception filters, and create custom domain exceptions with structured error codes.
whatYouLearn: How to throw GraphQLException in resolvers
How to implement IExceptionFilter for global handling
How to create custom domain exceptions
